artworks.title: Andromache and Pyrrhus
artworks.description: Guérin's Salon scene — Andromache before Pyrrhus in Epirus, Hector's widow as the Molossian prize of Achilles' son.

artworks.title: Captive Andromache
artworks.description: Leighton's captive — Andromache among the spoil, the Trojan queen whose Epirote fate this nostos seals.

artworks.title: The Death of Neoptolemus at Delphi (Pompeian fresco)
artworks.description: Pompeian fresco — Neoptolemus slain at Delphi, the Return's end after the Molossian kingdom.

artworks.title: Neoptolemus Killing Priam (Attic black-figure amphora)
artworks.artist: Attributed to the Class of Cambridge 49
artworks.description: Attic amphora — Neoptolemus killing Priam at the altar, the Troy chapter that opens his unscathed homecoming.

popCulture.title: Neoptolemus
popCulture.description: Achilles' son who alone of the horse's chiefs came home unscathed — then ruled in Epirus with Helenus, the Return that skipped the storm.
